arraial.fala.missao.pazes: %s, I fell out with %s... would you take them some food from me?
arraial.fala.missao.obrigado: Bless you, %s! I won't forget this.
arraial.fala.pazes_feitas: %s sent this? Then all is forgiven.
arraial.fala.favorita: My favourite food! You're an angel, %s!
arraial.fala.presente_amigo: Here, %s, a present from a friend.
arraial.conversa.briga.0.a: You again, %s? Out of my way.
arraial.conversa.briga.0.b: Out of mine, %s! Nobody can stand you.
arraial.ruina.esconderijo: The ruins of %s became a bandit hideout! %s of them are here.
arraial.ruina.limpo: The hideout of %s was cleared! The neighbours are grateful (and the loot stayed in the storehouse).
arraial.ruina.ataque: Bandits from the hideout in %s are coming tonight!
arraial.ruina.relatorio: Abandoned village: the houses are falling. Bring food to the storehouse and beds for people to return.
arraial.ruina.relatorio_bandidos: Ruins occupied by bandits. Drive them out before resettling.
arraial.cronica.esconderijo_limpo: %s drove the bandits out of the ruins.
arraial.cronica.esconderijo_limpo_viz: %s put an end to the bandit hideout in %s.
arraial.cronica.recolonizada: People from %s came to live in the ruins and the village lives again.
arraial.historia.recolonizada: Settlers from %s took the ruins and the village was reborn.
arraial.historia.colonizou: We sent settlers to the ruins of %s.
arraial.historia.bandidos_ocuparam: Bandits made the ruins of %s their hideout.
arraial.historia.esconderijo_perto: There is a bandit hideout in the ruins of %s: the roads are dangerous.
arraial.historia.saqueados: Bandits from the hideout in %s raided the village.
arraial.base.ocupada: Bandits took your old base as their hideout! %s of them are here.
arraial.base.sem_base: You have no base yet (sleep in a bed first).
arraial.base.forcada: Your base was taken by bandits. Go there.
arraial.jei.cruzeiro: Founds a village (48 block reach). Free beds draw villagers. Click: report; sneaking: chronicle; with a book: a copy of the chronicle.
arraial.jei.armazem: The village's stock: everyone's food and building materials. Villagers store and take from here.
arraial.jei.canteiro: Site Marker: pick the project with the Book of Projects and builders build it with materials from the Storehouse.
arraial.jei.livro_de_projetos: Click a Site Marker to choose what to build (houses, fields, well, town hall...).
arraial.jei.contrato_pedreiro: Click a villager to make them a builder.
arraial.jei.cepo: WOODCUTTER post: a villager without a trade becomes a woodcutter and brings logs and planks.
arraial.jei.balaio: FARMER post: plants and harvests wheat and cassava; wheat becomes bread.
arraial.jei.forno_olaria: POTTER post: turns clay into bricks, tiles and pottery.
arraial.jei.gamela: CLAY DIGGER post: digs clay in the direction the post faces.
arraial.jei.bancada_canteiro: QUARRYMAN post: opens a quarry (with a ladder) and brings stone.
arraial.jei.cocho: HERDER post: keeps the pen and brings wool, leather and meat. Animals near the trough are never hunted.
arraial.jei.posto_guarda: SOLDIER post: defends against monsters, bandits and militias; escorts the herder.
arraial.jei.forno_farinha: FLOUR MAKER post: cassava becomes flour (yields more than wheat), beiju and paçoca.
arraial.jei.banca_feira: SELLER post and market: réis in hand buys, goods sell, paper takes a supply order.
arraial.jei.cangalha: MULETEER post: takes surplus to other villages and brings back what is missing. Sword in hand: escort the troop.
arraial.jei.balcao_botica: APOTHECARY post: makes remedies from flowers and cures the sick in an epidemic.
arraial.jei.covo: FISHER post: fishes in water within 28 blocks.
arraial.jei.varal_caca: HUNTER post: hunts wild game (never pen, tame, leashed or named animals) and leaves 3 of each species.
arraial.jei.prancheta: ENGINEER post: lays streets, builds bridges and lamp posts with materials from the Storehouse.
arraial.jei.escrivaninha: Workstation of the RELAÇÕES PÚBLICAS. Click to open the Chancery: regional map, neighbours, treaties, tribute and embargo.
arraial.jei.urna: The village council: see the groups, propose with paper, campaign with réis.
arraial.jei.marco_fronteira: Extends the nearest village's territory (3x3 chunks). Counts as a border post in conflicts.
arraial.jei.bandeirinhas: Festa decoration. Four or more near the Cruzeiro make festas prettier.
arraial.jei.lampiao: Oil lamp with a flickering flame. Engineers use torch lamp posts.
arraial.jei.reis: The village currency. Earn it selling at the stall, filling orders, doing favours and escorting. Can also be minted from copper or gold.
arraial.jei.maniva: Cassava cutting: found by cutting grass or harvested from fields. Plant on farmland.
arraial.jei.mandioca: Harvested from ripe cassava. Smelt it into flour.
arraial.jei.farinha: Smelt cassava, or let the flour maker do it. Two flours make a beiju.
arraial.jei.remedio: Remedy: cures a sick villager (click them).
arraial.jei.guia: Book with everything about the mod. The founder of a village gets one.
arraial.jei.quentao: Hot festa drink: regeneration. Give it to villagers during a festa to earn recognition.
arraial.jei.cuia_garapa: Cane juice in a gourd: speed for 45 s.
arraial.jei.chapeu_couro: The backlands leather hat (worn on the head).
arraial.jei.facao: Backlands machete: hits hard. Pillagers sometimes carry one.
arraial.jei.peixeira: Long knife: less damage, very fast strikes.
arraial.jei.foice: Click a ripe crop: reaps 3x3 and replants.
arraial.jei.gibao: Part of the cowboy's leather. Hat + jerkin + chaps + alpargatas: cowboy agility.
arraial.jei.cantil: Click water to fill. Drunk, it removes hunger and poison.
arraial.jei.saco_saque: Carried by bandits and highwaymen. Click to open.
arraial.jei.comenda: The village's honour: for a child of the land or whoever clears a bandit hideout.

arraial.familia.crianca_nao: %s is still a child: cannot work.
arraial.cronica.casamento: A wedding at the Cruzeiro! %s and %s are now the %s family.
arraial.cronica.cresceu: %s %s grew up and can now learn a trade.
arraial.fala.casamento: Today is the happiest day of my life, %s!

arraial.jei.mapa_regiao: Shows the arraiais around: the land of each (in its flag colour), disputed land, roads (beaten, closed, at war, under embargo), ruins, bandits, you and your base. At an Escrivaninha the same map becomes the Chancery.
arraial.jei.taipa: The colonial wall: clay packed into a lattice of sticks. Builders raise taipa houses in the Colonial era.
arraial.jei.telha: Barrel clay roof tiles. In the Imperial era roofs become tiles (tile stairs and slabs).
arraial.jei.cal: Lime-whitewashed wall. In the Republican era the walls turn white.
arraial.jei.azulejo: Blue and white glazed tiles: the lower band of Republican façades.
arraial.mapa.vazio: No arraial nearby. Found one with a Cruzeiro or travel until you find one.
arraial.mapa.dica: Click an arraial (on the map or in the list) for details.
arraial.mapa.so_mesa: To negotiate, use the Escrivaninha of an arraial.
arraial.mapa.recebe: They pay us %s réis a day
arraial.diplomacia.nao_cabe: Proposing %s to %s makes no sense right now.
arraial.diplomacia.sem_papel: Every proposal goes in writing: bring paper.
arraial.cronica.embargo: %s declared an embargo on %s: no merchants, tropeiros or contracts.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.paz: Propose peace to an arraial at war with us. The chance grows with the length of the war and with our strength.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.comercio: Trade treaty (16 days): cheaper freight and better relations every day.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.alianca: Alliance (24 days): help in a crisis. Needs reputation 20 or more; hard to get.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.fronteira: In a land dispute: each side keeps the land closer to its Cruzeiro.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.tributo: Demand daily tribute (12 days). Only if we are much stronger (1.5x). A refusal raises tension.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.romper: Break the current treaty: reputation -15 and tension +20.
arraial.diplomacia.dica.embargo: Embargo: no merchants, tropeiros or contracts between the two; prices feel it. Ends trade and alliance. Click again to lift it.
arraial.guia.capa:
§6§lGuide to the Arraial§0

§oThe founder's manual§0

How to found a settlement in the backlands, grow it into a Cidade, deal with the neighbours and pass through the eras.

§8Turn the page for the contents.
arraial.guia.sumario_dica: Click a chapter to go there.
arraial.guia.inicio.1:
§2§lI. First days§0

§lBefore founding§0
• Cruzeiro: 5 logs of any wood in a cross
• Armazém: planks and a chest
• beds and food

Flat ground, with water and trees nearby.
arraial.guia.inicio.2:
§0§lFounding§0

Place the Cruzeiro: a Povoado is born, reaching 48 blocks. Another arraial must be 96+ blocks away.

Put the Armazém within reach and store food in it: the pantry of all.
arraial.guia.inicio.3:
§0§lThe first villagers§0

Every free bed draws people: one villager comes at a time, about every minute.

Without a trade, they look for a free workstation within reach and take it.
arraial.guia.inicio.4:
§0§lFirst works§0

1. Builder's Contract (paper, emerald, brick): use it on the ground.
2. Construction Marker (plank, stick, paper).
3. Book of Projects: pick the project and click the Marker.

Materials come from the Armazém.
arraial.guia.inicio.5:
§0§lFood at the start§0

Each villager eats 1 food a day from the Armazém. Hungry, they do not work; after 3 hungry days they leave.

Field + Basket: the farmer plants and bakes bread. Cassava cuttings turn up in the grass.
arraial.guia.inicio.6:
§0§lStarting list§0
☐ Cruzeiro
☐ Armazém with food
☐ 2 or 3 beds
☐ Builder
☐ Huts
☐ Field and Sawmill
☐ Well

With 6 villagers, Armazém and Well: §lArraial§0!
arraial.guia.meio.1:
§2§lII. Growing§0

§lThe mayor§0
With 4 villagers, the eldest becomes mayor and orders works on their own, as needed: houses, food, defence.

Once the Town Hall stands, they govern from there.
arraial.guia.meio.2:
§0§lStages§0
§lArraial§0: 6 villagers, Armazém, Well
§lVila§0: 14, Town Hall, Market
§lProsperous Vila§0: 24, Apothecary, Palisade
§lCidade§0: 40, Muleteer Ranch, satisfaction 60
arraial.guia.meio.3:
§0§lSatisfaction§0

Rises with food, homes, health, safety, services and festas; falls with crises and taxes.

Low: people leave and the mayor loses trust (new election).
High: people arrive faster.
arraial.guia.meio.4:
§0§lRéis and the Market§0

Réis: copper ingot and paper = 3 réis; gold ingot and paper = 12 réis.

At the Market Stall (by day, with a stallholder): réis in hand buys, goods in hand sells. Prices rise with scarcity and fall with plenty.
arraial.guia.meio.5:
§0§lSafety§0

At night monsters hunt villagers.

Guardhouse: soldiers.
Palisade: a fence with gates.
Engineer's posts: light.

Vaqueiro leather: protection and speed.
arraial.guia.meio.6:
§0§lCrises (1)§0

§lDrought§0: a well saves the field.
§lFlood§0: only in storms.
§lPests§0: chickens eat the caterpillars.
§lHighwaymen§0: raid the Armazém at night; killing them returns the loot.
arraial.guia.meio.7:
§0§lCrises (2)§0

§lEpidemic§0: the sick do not work; the apothecary cures with garrafada.
§lFire§0: everyone runs with buckets.

In the morning the mayor orders repairs. Allies send food.
arraial.guia.meio.8:
§0§lCalendar and festas§0

A year of 12 months of 2 days. April to October: dry season. November to March: rains.

Saint John (June 2), Patron Saint, Great Fair (Mar/Sep 1: 15% off) and each village's traditions.
arraial.guia.meio.9:
§0§lA good festa§0

Food to spare in the Armazém and Bunting make the festa better.

Go to the festa and bring sweets (pé-de-moleque, rapadura): you earn the people's recognition.
arraial.guia.meio.10:
§0§lNeighbours§0

Settlements spring up near yours and grow on their own.

The muleteer trades surpluses; the envoy visits.
An ally (reputation 50+) helps in crises; an enemy (-50) sends highwaymen.
arraial.guia.meio.11:
§0§lPolitics§0

Council: Farming, Crafts, Order, Commerce and People.

Ballot box: see the council.
Ballot box + paper: you propose (tax, works, festa...).
Réis in the box: a campaign, with a risk of scandal.
arraial.guia.fim.1:
§2§lIII. Greatness§0

§lEras§0
§lColonial§0: wattle and daub, dirt.
§lImperial§0: Vila + Pottery + 40 réis.
§lRepublican§0: Prosperous Vila + Chapel + Registry + 80 réis.

It changes on its own.
arraial.guia.fim.2:
§0§lThe reform§0
Every morning the builders reform houses and streets:
§lImperial§0: brick, tiles, cobbles, lanterns
§lRepublican§0: lime, azulejo, setts

Uses brick, clay and stone from the Armazém.
arraial.guia.fim.3:
§0§lEra works§0

Imperial unlocks the §lChapel§0 (bell, cross).
Republican unlocks the §lFountain§0 on the square.

Both bring satisfaction. The mayor orders them when the era comes.
arraial.guia.fim.4:
§0§lTerritory§0

Each arraial owns the chunks around it; it grows with stage and people.

Border Marker: adds 3x3 chunks.
As you walk, the screen says: lands of X, disputed, or no one's.
arraial.guia.fim.5:
§0§lTension and war§0

Shared land, the same resources, bad blood and robberies raise tension: it becomes a dispute, and at reputation -50, war.

In war: roads close, skirmishes; the weaker sues for peace and pays tribute.
arraial.guia.fim.6:
§0§lChancery§0

Escrivaninha: map and neighbours. Peace, Trade, Alliance, Border, Tribute, Break, Embargo.

1 paper per proposal, once a day; they may refuse.
arraial.guia.fim.7:
§0§lCulture§0

Each village has its own flag, customs and traditions.

Go to festas, bring sweets:
known → friend of the festa (you get the flag) → §lchild of the land§0 (Medal).
arraial.guia.fim.8:
§0§lFamilies§0

Villagers who are friends marry at the Cruzeiro and share a surname.
A couple with a bed and food to spare has children, who grow up in 3 days.

Under a coronel, the child inherits command.
arraial.guia.fim.9:
§0§lRuins and bandits§0

An abandoned village becomes a ruin; neighbours may resettle it, or bandits make a hideout.

Clear the hideout: réis, a loot chest, the Medal.
Your base left alone 8+ days may be taken too.
arraial.guia.fim.10:
§0§lOn to Cidade§0

☐ 40 villagers
☐ Muleteer Ranch
☐ Satisfaction 60+
☐ Republican era
☐ Chapel and Fountain
☐ Allies and beaten roads
☐ Child of the land

And plenty of festas.
arraial.guia.oficios.1:
§2§lIV. Trades§0

A villager without a trade takes a free workstation within reach.

Sneak, empty hand, click the villager: they drop the trade.

Next: each trade's station and work.
arraial.guia.oficios.2:
§0§lBuilder§0
Builder's Contract. Builds and repairs works.

§lWoodcutter§0
Chopping Block (axe + log). Fells and replants; makes planks, doors, fences, stairs, charcoal, torches, chests.
arraial.guia.oficios.3:
§0§lFarmer§0
Basket (hay + 2 sticks). Plants wheat and cassava, harvests, bakes bread.

§lHerder§0
Trough (planks + wheat). Breeds and brings animals to the pen; makes beds from wool.
arraial.guia.oficios.4:
§0§lPotter§0
Pottery Kiln (bricks + furnace). Bricks, stairs, slabs, mud bricks.

§lClay digger§0
Tub (shovel, clay, bowl). Digs clay.

§lQuarryman§0
Bench (pickaxe + stone). Stone.
arraial.guia.oficios.5:
§0§lFlour maker§0
Flour Oven (mud bricks, copper, bricks). Flour, beiju, paçoca.

§lFisher§0
Fish Trap (bamboo + string). Fishes.

§lHunter§0
Hide Rack (sticks). Hunts in the wild, never the pen.
arraial.guia.oficios.6:
§0§lStallholder§0
Market Stall. Buys and sells.

§lMuleteer§0
Pack Saddle (leather + slab). Carries goods to and fro.

§lApothecary§0
Apothecary Counter. Makes garrafada from flowers and cures the sick.
arraial.guia.oficios.7:
§0§lSoldier§0
Guard Post (2 swords + planks). Defends and escorts.

§lEngineer§0
Drafting Table (paper + slabs). Streets, bridges, lamp posts.

§lEnvoy§0
Escrivaninha (book, feather, ink). Visits the neighbours.
arraial.guia.comercio.1:
§2§lV. Commerce§0

§lAt the Stall§0
Réis in hand: buy what the stallholder shows.
Goods in hand: sell.

High reputation gives a discount. At the Great Fair, 15% off.
arraial.guia.comercio.2:
§0§lPeddler§0

Comes from a neighbouring village with real goods, taken from its stock.

Click them: buy and sell with réis. They leave at dusk. Road closed: they do not come.
arraial.guia.comercio.3:
§0§lOrders§0

Stall + paper: the arraial orders something it lacks, with a deadline and a reward.

Deliver at the Stall in time: réis and reputation.
arraial.guia.comercio.4:
§0§lMuleteers and roads§0

The muleteer takes the surplus and brings what is missing; they may be robbed.

Sword in hand as they leave: you escort (risk 1/4), paid later.
10+ trips: beaten road, 30% cheaper.
arraial.guia.comercio.5:
§0§lRegional prices§0

A neighbour with plenty makes things cheaper; a closed road, war or embargo makes them dearer.

Each village has a speciality (farming, mining...) and signs supply contracts with the others.
arraial.guia.itens.1:
§2§lVI. Items and blocks§0

§lTools§0
Machete: hits hard.
Peixeira: light and fast.
Sickle: reaps 3x3 and replants.

Iron and sticks, at the crafting table.
arraial.guia.itens.2:
§0§lVaqueiro leather§0

Leather hat, gibão, leggings and alpercatas (leather and string).

The full set gives speed. It also comes in bandit loot.
arraial.guia.itens.3:
§0§lFood and drink§0
Flour (smelt cassava), beiju, paçoca, rapadura (smelt cane), pé-de-moleque.
Cuia (pumpkin and bowl), garapa: speed.
Quentão: regeneration.
Flask: fill at water; clears hunger and poison.
arraial.guia.itens.4:
§0§lOthers§0
Garrafada: cures epidemics.
Loot sack: open it.
Medal: honour.
Bunting: festas.
Lantern, Ballot Box, Border Marker.
§lRegional Map§0: 3 paper, compass, ink.
arraial.guia.itens.5:
§0§lColonial blocks§0

§lWattle and daub§0: clay, sticks and dirt (8).
§lTiles§0: 2 bricks and clay (2); tile stairs and slabs.
§lLime§0: bone meal and clay, or calcite.
§lAzulejo§0: lime and blue dye.
arraial.guia.itens.6:
§0§lAdvancements§0

See the Arraial tab in advancements: founder, vaqueiro, escort, compadre, festa-goer, child of the land, peacemaker, bandit hunter, eras, wedding...

Each is an idea of what to do.
arraial.guia.dicas.1:
§2§lVII. Tips§0

Cruzeiro: report.
Sneaking: chronicle.
With a book: a copy of the chronicle.
Villager: talk, favours, card.
JEI: click a mod item to read what it does.
arraial.guia.dicas.2:
§0§lTest commands§0
/arraial crise
/arraial festa
/arraial era
/arraial casamento
/arraial mundo
/arraial avancar
/arraial guerra
/arraial obra_pronta

§oGood luck, founder!
arraial.engenho.esperando: waiting for the cane to grow
arraial.cafezal.esperando: waiting for the coffee to ripen
arraial.fala.oficio.mestre_engenho.0: Good cane makes rapadura like no other.
arraial.fala.oficio.mestre_engenho.1: The mill never stops while there's cane in the field.
arraial.fala.oficio.cafeicultor.0: Good coffee is picked bright red.
arraial.fala.oficio.cafeicultor.1: Fancy a cafezinho? Just roasted it.
arraial.fala.oficio.entalhador.0: Every leaf of this carving takes a day of chisel.
arraial.fala.oficio.entalhador.1: When the Matriz is done, it will shine with gold.
arraial.historia.disputa.colonial: The frontier with %s heats up: Portuguese on one side, Spanish on the other.
advancements.arraial.cafezinho.title: Fancy a Cafezinho?
advancements.arraial.queijo_coalho.title: Queijo Coalho
advancements.arraial.queijo_coalho.descr: Eat a queijo coalho made at the corral
advancements.arraial.matriz_barroca.desc: See the builders finish a Mother Church
advancements.arraial.missao.title: Across the Frontier
advancements.arraial.missao.description: Enter the lands of a Spanish mission
arraial.jei.moenda: Workstation of the SUGAR MASTER. Cuts the cane around it, plants new cane by the water and grinds it: half becomes sugar, half rapadura.
arraial.jei.terreiro: Workstation of the COFFEE GROWER. Picks ripe coffee bushes, plants new ones, and dries and roasts the cherries (2 cherries = 1 roasted coffee).
arraial.jei.bancada_entalhe: Workstation of the CARVER. Makes gilded carving (planks and a gold nugget) for the Baroque Mother Church.
arraial.jei.cafe_cereja: Picked from a ripe coffee bush. Planted in dirt it grows a new bush; smelted it becomes roasted coffee.
arraial.jei.cafezinho: Cuia, roasted coffee and sugar. Haste (faster mining and digging) for a minute and a half.
arraial.jei.queijo_coalho: The herder makes it every morning from the milk of the corral's cows (one cheese for two cows).
arraial.jei.charque: Salted, dried beef: the herder makes it from spare beef in the storehouse, or you can at a campfire (slowly).
arraial.jei.pedra_sabao: The stone of the Baroque of Minas. In mining towns from the Imperial era, foundations and paving become soapstone.
arraial.jei.talha_dourada: Carved, gilded wood of the Baroque altars. Used in the altarpiece of the Mother Church.
arraial.jei.adobe: Sun-dried bricks of mud and straw: the wall of the Spanish missions.
arraial.guia.oficios.8:
§0§lSugar master§0
Sugar Mill. Cuts and plants cane; grinds sugar and rapadura.

§lCoffee grower§0
Drying Yard (3 bricks). Picks, plants, roasts coffee.

§lCarver§0
Carver's Bench. Gilded carving.
arraial.guia.fim.11:
§0§lFazendas§0

With 7 villagers and water: a Sugar Mill (cane, sugar, rapadura).
In the Imperial era: a Coffee Plantation.

The herder makes queijo coalho from the corral's milk and charque from spare beef.
arraial.guia.fim.12:
§0§lBaroque§0

In the Imperial era a Prosperous Vila (or a mining Vila) brings a carver and raises the §lMother Church§0: lime, soapstone and gilded carving.

Mining towns get white houses on soapstone.
arraial.guia.fim.13:
§0§lSpanish missions§0

Some neighbours are missions: Spanish names, the cross of Burgundy, adobe walls and a church with a bell-gable.

On the frontier, tension rises more easily.
arraial.guia.itens.7:
§0§lFarm and Baroque§0
Coffee cherry: plant or smelt.
Cafezinho: cuia, coffee, sugar.
Queijo coalho, charque.
§lSoapstone§0: 4 stone, clay.
§lGilded carving§0: planks, nugget.
§lAdobe§0: mud, wheat.
arraial.config.servidor: On a server, the server's config/arraial.json applies
arraial.config.vizinhas_perto.dica: Autonomous villages appear near your arraial, so you have someone to trade, negotiate and quarrel with.
arraial.config.max_autonomas.dica: How many autonomous villages may exist in the world at once.
arraial.config.chance_missao.dica: Chance that a new autonomous village is a Spanish mission.
arraial.config.bases_ocupadas.dica: Your base, left alone for many days outside any territory, may be taken by bandits.
arraial.config.crises.dica: Drought, flood, pests, highwaymen, epidemics and fire.
arraial.config.frequencia_crises.dica: 100% is normal; 0% almost never; 300% much more often.
arraial.config.chegada_segundos.dica: Seconds between newcomers while there are free beds.
arraial.config.soldados_armazem.dica: Soldiers wear the best armour and weapon in the storehouse, from any mod.
arraial.config.aviso_fronteira.dica: Shows "Lands of..." when crossing a border.
arraial.config.waypoints_mapa.dica: Villages you know appear as waypoints on Xaero's Minimap and World Map.
arraial.jade.posto_livre: free: waiting for a villager without a trade
item.arraial.baiao_de_dois: Baião de Dois (Rice and Beans with Cheese)
arraial.colonos.chegando: In the distance, a caravan of settlers with a laden donkey looks for good land to found a hamlet.
arraial.colonos.chegando_missao: In the distance, Spanish friars and settlers with a laden donkey look for land to found a mission.
arraial.colonos.fundaram: The settlers plant the Cruzeiro: %s is born!
arraial.cronica.colonos: A caravan of settlers arrived with a laden donkey, planted the Cruzeiro and lit the first campfire.
arraial.config.fundacao_ao_vivo.dica: New villages are founded before your eyes: a caravan of settlers arrives, plants the Cruzeiro and the builder raises the first works. Off: they appear ready.
arraial.cronica.improviso: With nobody to make what was missing, %s improvised a %s: now someone can be a %s.
arraial.jei.capivara_spawn_egg: Capybara: lives in groups by rivers, lakes and swamps of warm lands. Tame, a good swimmer; breed with melon, sugar cane or wheat. Drops leather and meat.
arraial.jei.tamandua_spawn_egg: Giant anteater: wanders slowly and alone through savannas and plains. Harmless; breed with sweet or glow berries.
arraial.jei.jacare_spawn_egg: Caiman: lurks at the water's edge. On dry land it leaves you alone, but it bites whoever comes close to the bank and snatches chickens and young capybaras. Breed with fish.
arraial.jei.onca_spawn_egg: Jaguar: lord of the jungle. Slips away from people unless attacked, but now and then hunts capybaras and farm animals. A village near the jungle wants its soldiers.
arraial.jei.arara_spawn_egg: Macaw: red, blue-and-yellow or hyacinth, in jungles and savannas. Flies, perches and dances like a parrot (tame it with seeds), but it is too big for your shoulder.
arraial.guia.fauna.1:
§lAnimals of Brazil§0

§lCapybara§0: in groups by the water in warm lands. Tame; breed with melon, sugar cane or wheat.

§lGiant anteater§0: alone in savannas and plains. Harmless; likes berries.

§lMacaw§0: in jungles and savannas; tame with seeds.
arraial.guia.fauna.2:
§lCaiman§0: on riverbanks and in swamps. Harmless on dry land, but it bites whoever comes to the bank and takes chickens.

§lJaguar§0: in the jungle (and, rarely, the savanna). Avoids people, but hunts capybaras, pigs, sheep and chickens, even in the corral.

§8Village near the jungle: a guard post by the cocho.
arraial.fala.oficio.barqueiro.0: The river is the gentlest road there is.
arraial.fala.oficio.barqueiro.1: Full canoe, steady paddle, and an eye out for caimans.
arraial.barqueiro.enchente: the river is in flood: the canoe stays moored
arraial.cronica.canoa_partiu: %s took the canoe down the river to %s.
arraial.cronica.canoa_virou: %s's canoe tipped over in the rapids on the way to %s: half the load went down the river.
arraial.cronica.canoa_voltou: %s came back by canoe from %s: sold the load for %s réis and brought %s good(s).
arraial.jei.amarra: BOATMAN's workstation, on the jetty at the water's edge. The boatman takes the armazém's surplus by canoe to villages that also have a jetty: more cargo and faster than the mule troop, and no robbers. During a flood the canoe stays moored.
arraial.guia.rios.1:
§lJetty and boatman§0

An arraial by the water builds a §ltrapiche§0: a jetty over the river with the boatman's mooring post.

The §lboatman§0 takes the armazém's surplus by canoe to villages that also have a jetty. More cargo than the mule troop, faster, and no robbers.

§8During a flood the canoe stays moored.
arraial.fala.oficio.estivador.0: When the ship whistles, the wharf wakes up.
arraial.fala.oficio.estivador.1: Sugar sacks go up, salt sacks come down.
arraial.estivador.carregando: loading a lot at the storehouse
arraial.estivador.embarcando: carrying the lot to the crane
arraial.navio.chegou: The ship %s has moored at the port of %s! Captain %s sells salt, iron and chita and buys sugar, coffee, rapadura, leather and charque.
arraial.navio.partiu: The ship %s set sail: the village sold %s réis of goods and bought %s réis of salt, iron and chita.
arraial.navio.vendeu: You sold %s %s to the captain for %s réis.
arraial.cronica.navio_chegou: The ship %s moored at the port.
arraial.cronica.navio_partiu: The ship %s set sail: we sold %s réis and bought %s réis of salt, iron and chita.
arraial.fala.capitao.0: Salt from the Kingdom, iron and fine chita! Who's buying?
arraial.fala.capitao.1: I pay well for sugar and coffee, they're worth gold overseas.
arraial.fala.capitao.2: We sail at dusk, make the most of it!
arraial.fala.capitao_nao_quer: That's not worth the freight. Bring sugar, coffee, rapadura, leather or charque.
arraial.comando.sem_porto: This village has no finished port.
arraial.jei.guindaste: Workstation of the STEVEDORE, at the end of the port's wharf. While a ship is in port, the stevedore takes the storehouse surplus (sugar, roasted coffee, rapadura, leather, charque) to the crane and comes back with the salt, iron and chita the village bought.
arraial.jei.sal: Arrives on the merchant ship at the port. Three raw beef and a sack of salt make three charque at the crafting table.
arraial.jei.chita: Printed cloth that arrives by ship. One chita and one string make eight festa bunting.
arraial.guia.rios.2:
§lPort and merchant ship§0

A village on the coast (deep water nearby) builds a §lport§0: a stone warehouse and a long wharf with the stevedore's crane.

Now and then a §lship§0 moors alongside the wharf. The captain sells salt, iron and chita and buys sugar, coffee, rapadura, leather and charque.

The §lstevedore§0 carries the storehouse surplus to the ship and brings back what the village bought.

§8The ship sails at dusk.
arraial.fala.oficio.moleiro.0: Water in the river, flour in the sack.
arraial.fala.oficio.moleiro.1: Every sheaf that goes into the stones comes out as two of flour.
arraial.jei.mo: Workstation of the MILLER, inside the water mill. The miller grinds the storehouse wheat into wheat flour (one sheaf makes two), and the farmer bakes a loaf from two flours: three times the bread per wheat.
arraial.jei.roda_dagua: The mill wheel: it turns by itself while there is water under or beside it.
arraial.jei.monjolo: A water-driven pestle: with water close by it pounds all day on its own. A village with a finished monjolo makes cassava flour twice as fast, and the coffee grower roasts twice the coffee without losing beans.
arraial.jei.farinha_trigo: Ground at the water mill. Bake it in a furnace or smoker to get bread.
arraial.guia.rios.3:
§lWater mill and monjolo§0

The §lmill§0 stands on the river bank: the wheel turns in the water and the §lmillstone§0 grinds the wheat. The §lmiller§0 makes wheat flour and bread goes three times as far.

The §lmonjolo§0 is a pestle the water drives by itself: cassava flour and coffee come out twice as fast.

§8Without water, wheel and monjolo stand still.
arraial.cronica.estrada_pronta: %s finished the road to %s: the troop now travels faster and safer.
arraial.guia.rios.4:
§lBridges and roads§0

Where a street or road crosses water, the §lengineer§0 builds a plank bridge one block above the river, with railings and log pillars.

He also opens the §lroad§0 towards the two nearest neighbouring villages, some seventy blocks out from the Cruzeiro.

With the road finished, the troop to that village arrives a quarter sooner and runs half the risk of robbery.

§8Bridges use planks from the storehouse.
arraial.fala.oficio.ferroviario.0: The train waits for no one: the whistle blows at seven sharp.
arraial.fala.oficio.ferroviario.1: With the rails, the village is next door to the capital.
arraial.cronica.trem_partiu: The train left the station for %s.
arraial.cronica.trem_voltou: %s came back by train from %s: sold the load for %s réis and brought %s good(s).
arraial.jei.bilheteria: Workstation of the RAILWAYMAN, at the station (Republican era). The train takes the storehouse surplus to villages that also have a station: the biggest load, the quickest trip and no robbery. Between two stations the regional freight is halved.
arraial.guia.rios.5:
§lStation and train§0

In the Republican era, a village of ten or more builds the §lstation§0: a brick house, a covered platform and a track.

The §lrailwayman§0 loads the wagons at the storehouse and the train leaves for villages that also have a station.

The train carries more than the troop and the canoe, arrives the same day and is never robbed.

§8Between two stations freight costs half.
arraial.livro.pedido_marca: ★ This is what the mayor is asking for.
arraial.livro.dica_marco: Builders raise it from this marker, in the direction it points.
arraial.livro.dica_ar: Choose, then right-click a Construction Marker with the book. Enter confirms.
arraial.livro.escolhido: Blueprint chosen: %s. Now right-click a Construction Marker with the book.
projeto.arraial.casebre.desc: A small mud-brick house for one family. Cheap and quick: the hamlet's first roof.
projeto.arraial.rancho.desc: A wooden house for one family, a little bigger than the mud hut.
projeto.arraial.poco.desc: Water for the people. Required to become an Arraial, and it saves the village in a drought.
projeto.arraial.serraria.desc: The woodcutter turns logs into planks, doors and fences.
projeto.arraial.roca.desc: Wheat and cassava fields tended by the farmer. The village's food.
projeto.arraial.olaria.desc: The potter's kiln: clay becomes bricks and tiles for better houses.
projeto.arraial.curral.desc: The herder's cattle, sheep and chickens: leather, wool, eggs, cheese and charque.
projeto.arraial.barreira.desc: The clay digger's pit, where the potter's clay comes from.
projeto.arraial.pedreira.desc: The quarryman's quarry: stone for foundations, streets and walls.
projeto.arraial.casa_de_farinha.desc: Cassava becomes flour and beiju in the flour maker's hands. Feeds many people.
projeto.arraial.pesqueiro.desc: Fish traps at the water's edge for the fisher. Needs a river, lake or sea.
projeto.arraial.rancho_cacador.desc: The hunter's lodge; the hunter brings meat and leather from the wild.
projeto.arraial.engenho.desc: The sugar master's cane mill: sugar and rapadura. Stands near water.
projeto.arraial.cafezal.desc: Coffee bushes and drying yard (Imperial era): roasted coffee and cafezinho.
projeto.arraial.oficina_entalhe.desc: The carver's workshop, making the gilded woodwork of Baroque churches.
projeto.arraial.moinho.desc: The wheel turns in the river and the miller grinds wheat into flour: three times the bread.
projeto.arraial.monjolo.desc: A water-driven pestle: cassava flour and coffee come out twice as fast.
projeto.arraial.feira.desc: The vendor's market stalls, with supply-and-demand prices. Required to become a Vila.
projeto.arraial.rancho_tropeiro.desc: The muleteer's lodge; the troop sells the surplus in neighbouring villages.
projeto.arraial.trapiche.desc: A deck over the river with the boatman's mooring post: canoe trade with other river villages.
projeto.arraial.porto.desc: A coastal quay with the stevedore's crane. Now and then a merchant ship moors.
projeto.arraial.estacao.desc: Railway station (Republican era): the railwayman sends big loads to other villages with a station.
projeto.arraial.prefeitura.desc: The village's seat of government. The mayor asks for it at 8 villagers; required to become a Vila.
projeto.arraial.botica.desc: The apothecary's counter: medicine, and care for the sick in epidemics.
projeto.arraial.cartorio.desc: The envoy's desk: treaties, diplomatic missions and the Chancery.
projeto.arraial.oficina_engenheiro.desc: The engineer's drafting table; the engineer lays streets, roads, bridges and lamp posts.
projeto.arraial.chafariz.desc: A fountain on the square (Republican era). Makes the village prettier and the people happier.
projeto.arraial.capela.desc: The village chapel (Imperial era), where the patron saint's festas are held.
projeto.arraial.matriz.desc: The Baroque mother church with gilded woodwork. The great church of a rich town.
projeto.arraial.missao.desc: The Spanish mission church, of adobe with a bell gable.
projeto.arraial.guarita.desc: The soldier's post, watching the village against highwaymen and monsters.
projeto.arraial.muralha.desc: A wooden palisade around the village. Keeps the night and the highwaymen outside.
